threadDescriptions.ridge-route: Plan the walking route and overnight camp on the Slate Ridge weekend.
threadDescriptions.ridge-food: Prepare meals and drinking-water logistics for the Slate Ridge hikers.
threadDescriptions.tent-repair: Patch and test the leaking two-person tent before the trip.
threadDescriptions.cat-sitter: Arrange care of Miso at home during the weekend away.
threadDescriptions.work-handoff: Hand off the Friday client report before taking leave.

items.text: Slate Ridge Saturday: bus to Mill Gate, climb by the eastern path, camp at the old quarry. Seven kilometres carrying packs.
Miso sitter: Ana can do Saturday dinner but needs the key before Friday. Cat food is in the red cupboard.
Tent test in shower: slow drip along the foot-end seam. Mark the wet spot with tape; buy seam sealer.
items.rationale: Locates tent leak and repair supply.

items.text: Ridge food for three: oats twice, lentil packets Saturday night, wraps for lunches. Ben cannot eat sesame.
items.rationale: Defines group menu and allergy constraint.

items.text: Friday client report handoff: Jules needs the draft charts by Thursday noon to cover my leave.
Map enlargement shows the quarry is inside the no-camping zone. Revise Slate Ridge overnight stop to Juniper Field; add two kilometres to Saturday.
Tent foot seam cleaned and sealed. Cure flat indoors for a full day before repeating the water test.
Voice memo lost the start: 'three, red one, before Friday'.
items.rationale: Shared timing and generic descriptors cannot identify a thread.

items.text: Juniper Field has a tap by the gate, but the notice says seasonal. Phone the caretaker before deciding how much water to carry on the ridge.
items.rationale: Plans trip drinking water using campsite infrastructure.

items.text: Ana has the key and Miso's feeding card. She asked me to leave a light on a timer.
Client report charts exported. Jules spotted a missing legend on revenue; fix it before sending the Thursday handoff.

Call with caretaker: Juniper Field tap shut this weekend. Move the route's lunch stop to Mill Spring for a refill, and pack an extra two-litre bladder plus a no-boil dinner so our water plan still works.
items.rationale: Changes the walking stop and concrete food/water plan.

items.text: Second tent shower test: the foot seam stays dry after ten minutes. Repack only when the fly has dried.
Rename our 'Slate Ridge weekend' route sheet to 'Juniper loop'. It's still the same bus, walkers and revised Juniper Field camp; easier to distinguish from last year's ridge plan.
items.rationale: Explicitly renames the route plan without changing identity.

items.text: Lentil packet labels have sesame oil. Replace all three with the chickpea pouches; Ben checked those ingredients.
items.rationale: Corrects menu to meet established allergy constraint.

items.text: Miso's sitter backup is Omar if Ana's late shift runs over. Both have the same feeding card; don't double the evening meal.
items.rationale: Plans coverage and avoids duplicate feeding.

items.text: Jules received the client report with revenue legend restored. Leave note says he owns any Friday edits.
Juniper loop GPX now includes Mill Spring and the extra distance. Download it before leaving mobile coverage.
Green bag by the door. Check whether it has the small one.
Ridge meals packed: sesame-free chickpeas, wraps, oats, extra bladder. Put Ben's marked pouch at the top for the spring lunch stop.
items.rationale: Final trip meal and water packing.
